title: A button's build asks the column question in the chat, and small row drops that add up ask first
request: The owner chose to clear what the review of 2026-10-28 left open before the next plans.
spec: The Team panel's Build (and the summary's) refused with H3.1's column check left no question in the chat; a recipe's guard asked only about a step that removed more than the guard's share alone.
plan: Ask the column question in the chat when a build from a button is refused by the column check.
Count the rows removed since the person's last yes, and ask when the steps together pass the guard.
Test both, and check the Home measurement on dev is unchanged.

decisions.decision: The route asks the question where the refusal is raised; the open questions the person built past are closed.
decisions.why: The person's next reply must be read as the column's answer, which then carries the build on, as after build it in the chat.

decisions.decision: Removed rows are counted from the table the person last said yes to.
decisions.why: After a yes, what follows is new; counting from the original would ask again about rows already accepted.

change: dclab_rnd/draft/api.py build_and_run asks the column question on a column-check refusal; chat.py ask_column_check closes the questions the build went past; chat.py run_recipe counts rows removed since the last yes. Tests: test_a_button_build_asks_the_column_question_in_the_chat, test_small_filters_that_together_remove_many_rows_ask_first; ROADMAP's open items updated.

findings.defect: A build from the Team panel refused by the column check asked nothing in the chat.
findings.scenario: The person pressed Build on the Team panel; the page said the team could not build with the question's text, and their reply in the chat was not read as the answer.
findings.cause: Only the chat's build it path asked the column question; the route raised a 409.
findings.fix: The route asks the question before it raises; an open question the person built past is closed so the reply answers the column.

findings.defect: A chain of small filters could remove many rows without a question.
findings.scenario: Two filters, each under the guard's share, removed more than it together; nothing was asked.
findings.cause: The guard read each step against the table just before it.
findings.fix: Rows removed since the last yes are counted, and the step that passes the share is asked, with the reason said.

outcome: A refused build from any button asks its column question where the person answers, and no table loses many rows to small steps without a yes.
lessons: A guard per step is not a guard on the result: count against the last thing the person agreed to.
risks: A model can still split a large drop across a yes; each yes is the person's, said with its count.
